# faofishingreport

> 📘 **中文文档**：[faofishingreport
> 中文网站](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/index.html)（网站右上角也可以随时切换中文）

**faofishingreport** turns the [FAO Global Capture
Production](https://www.fao.org/fishery/collection/capture/en)
statistics into charts, maps and tables for reports, by fishing area,
country and species, in English, Chinese or both.

## ✨ Features

- 💾 **Always the latest data**: check for and download new FAO releases
  with one command, and compare releases to see what FAO revised.
- 🌊 **Fishing area analyses**: total catch with breakpoints, share of
  the world marine catch, main species, main countries, maps.
- 🐟 **Species and country profiles**: who catches a species, what a
  country catches, where it fishes and how far its distant-water fleet
  goes.
- 📊 **Summary analyses**: species groups, stock status plots, peak and
  trend, data quality, diversity and concentration, country groups,
  synchronous breakpoints, coastal and distant-water fleets, pelagic to
  demersal ratio, and all FAO marine areas compared.
- 🔬 **Analyses from the literature**: catch shocks (Cottrell et
  al. 2019; Gephart et al. 2017), fishery collapses (Mullon et al. 2005;
  Worm et al. 2006) with a random null model, synchrony and portfolio
  effect (Loreau & de Mazancourt 2008).
- 🌡️ **FishBase and sea temperature**: FishBase and SeaLifeBase traits
  matched to FAO species (data snapshots of the
  [rfishbase](https://github.com/ropensci/rfishbase) project), sea
  surface temperature of the FAO areas, and the mean temperature of the
  catch (Cheung et al. 2013).
- 📉 **CMSY++ stock assessment** of the main species (Froese et
  al. 2023; code of its authors from
  <https://github.com/SISTA16/cmsyPlusPlus>, bundled unchanged), with
  JAGS set up for your computer, charts, projections and tables of
  reference points and priors.
- 📝 **Assessment report in one call**:
  [`fao_report()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_report.md)
  writes a report in Chinese or English, as Word, LaTeX or PDF (cover,
  abstract, data and methods, results, conclusions, references,
  appendix), with every analysis switched on or off and the settings of
  each function given with a prefix.
- 🌐 **English, Chinese or bilingual** charts with the official FAO
  Chinese names.
- 🎨 **Your style**: themes, colour palettes, map projections (Robinson,
  Mollweide, Equal Earth, …) and Pacific-centred maps, set once with
  [`fao_settings()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_settings.md).
- 💻 **Windows, macOS and Linux**: a Chinese font is chosen
  automatically; tables open in Excel with Chinese names intact.

## 📦 Installation

faofishingreport needs R 4.2 or later. Install it from GitHub:

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Linbojun99/faofishingreport", dependencies = TRUE)
```

All the packages it uses are installed with it (Word reports,
PowerPoint, FishBase, sea surface temperature, CMSY++). CMSY++ also
needs the JAGS program: run
[`cmsy_setup()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_setup.md)
once. On macOS, editable PowerPoint charts need
[XQuartz](https://www.xquartz.org).

## 🚀 Quick start

``` r

library(faofishingreport)

# Get the latest FAO release (only needed when FAO publishes a new one)
check_fao_update()
download_fao_data()

# FAO major fishing area 34, Eastern Central Atlantic
FAO34 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
fishing_area_species(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 10))
fishing_area_country(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 10))

# Who catches European pilchard, what Morocco catches
species_country(FAO34$area_data, "European pilchard(=Sardine)", lang = "both")
country_species(FAO34$area_data, "Morocco")

# Summary analyses and analyses from the literature
stock_status(FAO34$area_data)
catch_shocks(FAO34$area_data)
mean_temperature_catch(FAO34$area_data, version = "builtin")

# CMSY++ for the ten main species (run cmsy_setup() once before)
cmsy_area("Atlantic, Eastern Central", top = 10)

# An assessment report of the area, in Chinese, with CMSY++ and catch shocks,
# as Word and PDF (LaTeX)
report <- fao_report(34, lang = "zh", cmsy = TRUE, shocks = TRUE, format = c("docx", "pdf"))
```

Charts are saved in `figures/png/` (and, if you want, editable
PowerPoint in `figures/pptx/`), tables in `tables/`.

## 🔧 Function reference

**💾 FAO data**

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`check_fao_update()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/check_fao_update.md) | Compare the latest FAO release online with the data on your computer |
| [`download_fao_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/download_fao_data.md) | Download a release and convert it to the package format |
| [`load_fao_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/load_fao_data.md) | Load the newest downloaded release, or the bundled data |
| [`fao_data_info()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_data_info.md) | The FAO release used, its download link and citation |
| [`fao_data_dir()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_data_dir.md) | Folder where downloaded releases are stored |

**🌊 Fishing areas**

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`fishing_area_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishing_area_data.md) | Catch of one FAO fishing area: trend, breakpoints, share of the world marine catch, map |
| [`fishing_area_species()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishing_area_species.md) | Main species of an area, their catch and breakpoints |
| [`fishing_area_country()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishing_area_country.md) | Main countries of an area, their catch and breakpoints |

**🐟 Species and countries**

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`species_country()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/species_country.md) | Countries catching a species: ranking, trends, map, pie charts by decade |
| [`country_species()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_species.md) | Species caught by a country in an area |
| [`country_analysis()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_analysis.md) | A country’s catch in all FAO areas, by species and area, with a map |

**📊 Summary analyses**

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`species_group_composition()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/species_group_composition.md) | Catch by ISSCAAP species group or major group |
| [`stock_status()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/stock_status.md) | Stock status plots: developing, exploited, over-exploited, collapsed, rebuilding |
| [`peak_trend()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/peak_trend.md) | Peak year, last year as % of peak and recent trend of species, countries or areas |
| [`area_overview()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/area_overview.md) | All FAO marine areas compared |
| [`data_quality()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/data_quality.md) | Official versus estimated catch, and catch identified to species |
| [`diversity_concentration()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/diversity_concentration.md) | Species and country numbers, Shannon diversity, HHI, top-N shares |
| [`country_group_summary()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_group_summary.md) | Catch by income group, continent or region |
| [`regime_shift()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/regime_shift.md) | Breakpoints of the main species and years when many change together |
| [`coastal_distant()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/coastal_distant.md) | Catch by coastal countries and distant-water fleets |

**🔬 Analyses from the literature**

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`catch_shocks()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/catch_shocks.md) | Catch shocks (Cottrell et al. 2019 or Gephart et al. 2017), by year and group |
| [`collapse_analysis()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/collapse_analysis.md) | Fishery collapses (Mullon et al. 2005 or Worm et al. 2006) against random series |
| [`catch_synchrony()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/catch_synchrony.md) | Synchrony of species or country catches and the portfolio effect |
| [`distant_water_profile()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/distant_water_profile.md) | A country’s catch in adjacent and distant-water FAO areas over time |
| [`compare_releases()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/compare_releases.md) | Records revised, added or removed between two FAO releases |
| [`pelagic_demersal()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/pelagic_demersal.md) | Pelagic to demersal catch ratio (Caddy 1993; de Leiva Moreno et al. 2000) |
| [`fao_pd_groups()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_pd_groups.md) | ISSCAAP groups counted as pelagic or demersal |

**🌡️ FishBase and temperature**

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`check_fishbase_update()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/check_fishbase_update.md) | Latest FishBase and SeaLifeBase releases and the ones downloaded |
| [`download_fishbase_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/download_fishbase_data.md) | Download FishBase and SeaLifeBase tables |
| [`fishbase_table()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishbase_table.md) | Read a FishBase or SeaLifeBase table |
| [`fishbase_match()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishbase_match.md) | Match FAO species items to FishBase and SeaLifeBase, with their traits |
| [`fishbase_sources()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishbase_sources.md) | Sources, licences and matching rules of the traits |
| [`fao_sst_products()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_sst_products.md) | Sea surface temperature products and their references |
| [`download_sst_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/download_sst_data.md) | Download a sea surface temperature product |
| [`fao_area_sst()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_area_sst.md) | Sea surface temperature of the FAO areas by year |
| [`mean_temperature_catch()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/mean_temperature_catch.md) | Mean temperature of the catch and its trend, compared with SST |

**📉 CMSY++ stock assessment**

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`cmsy_area()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_area.md) | CMSY++ for the main species of an area in one call |
| [`cmsy_system()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_system.md) | Check the computer: R, JAGS and the packages CMSY++ needs |
| [`cmsy_setup()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_setup.md) | Install JAGS and the R packages of CMSY++ |
| [`cmsy_jags_versions()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_jags_versions.md) | JAGS and rjags versions that match each R version |
| [`cmsy_download_jags()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_download_jags.md) | Download the JAGS installer for the computer |
| [`cmsy_install_jags()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_install_jags.md) | Install JAGS |
| [`cmsy_sources()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_sources.md) | Versions, links and citations of everything CMSY++ uses |
| [`cmsy_priors()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_priors.md) | Priors of r from FishBase and SeaLifeBase |
| [`cmsy_input()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_input.md) | FAO catch data to CMSY++ input files |
| [`cmsy_defaults()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_defaults.md) | CMSY++ settings and their defaults |
| [`cmsy_run()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_run.md) | Run CMSY++ |
| [`cmsy_plot()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_plot.md) | Charts of the CMSY++ results |
| [`cmsy_forecast()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_forecast.md) | Projections under fishing scenarios |
| [`cmsy_compare()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_compare.md) | Compare CMSY++ runs |
| [`cmsy_tables()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_tables.md) | Tables of priors and results for reports |

**📝 Reports**

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`fao_report()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_report.md) | Word assessment report of a fishing area, in Chinese or English, with every analysis switched on or off |

**🎨 Settings and language**

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`fao_settings()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_settings.md) | Language, theme, palettes, map projection and centre, grid lines, output |
| [`fao_font()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_font.md) | Font of chart text |
| [`fao_translate()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_translate.md) | Chinese or bilingual names of countries, species and areas |

## 📊 Data source

The package comes with the FAO [Global Capture
Production](https://www.fao.org/fishery/collection/capture/en)
statistics, **release 2026.1.0** (published by FAO on 30 March 2026;
catches 1950–2024), downloaded on 10 October 2026 from
<https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/Data/Capture_2026.1.0.zip>.

- All releases: <https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/Data/>.
  [`check_fao_update()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/check_fao_update.md)
  and
  [`download_fao_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/download_fao_data.md)
  find and download newer ones.
- Species names: FAO [ASFIS
  list](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/ASFIS/ASFIS_sp.zip); Chinese
  names of countries, species and areas from the FAO code lists in the
  release.
- Licence: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/),
  with the [FAO terms of
  use](https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en).
- [`fao_data_info()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_data_info.md)
  shows the release your analyses use and how to cite it.
- FAO websites: [FAO](https://www.fao.org/home/en), [FAOSTAT
  data](https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data) and the [FAO fishery data
  files](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/Data/).

> This package is not affiliated with FAO; the data come from FAO.

## 📝 Citation

``` r

citation("faofishingreport")
```

Please also cite the FAO data, e.g. with the citation given by
[`fao_data_info()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_data_info.md):

> FAO. 2026. Global Capture Production 1950-2024, release 2026.1.0. In:
> Fisheries and Aquaculture \[online\]. Rome. \[Cited 10 October 2026\].
> <https://www.fao.org/fishery/collection/capture/en>. Licence: CC BY
> 4.0.

# Package index

## 💾 FAO data

Check for, download and load FAO Global Capture Production releases.

- [`check_fao_update()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/check_fao_update.md)
  : Check for the Latest FAO Global Capture Production Release
- [`download_fao_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/download_fao_data.md)
  : Download an FAO Global Capture Production Release
- [`load_fao_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/load_fao_data.md)
  : Load FAO Global Capture Production Data
- [`fao_data_info()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_data_info.md)
  : Information on the FAO Data Used
- [`fao_data_dir()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_data_dir.md)
  : Directory for Downloaded FAO Data

## 🌊 Fishing areas

Total catch, main species and main countries of an FAO fishing area.

- [`fishing_area_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishing_area_data.md)
  : Extract Data for a Specified Fishing Area and Optionally Generate
  Plots
- [`fishing_area_species()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishing_area_species.md)
  : Fishing Area Species Analysis
- [`fishing_area_country()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishing_area_country.md)
  : Fishing Area Country Analysis

## 🐟 Species and countries

Who catches a species, what a country catches, and a country’s global
catch.

- [`species_country()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/species_country.md)
  : Analyze and Plot Specified Species Data Ranked by Country Production
- [`country_species()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_species.md)
  : Analyze and Plot the Main Species Caught by a Country in a Fishing
  Area
- [`country_analysis()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_analysis.md)
  : Analyze and Plot the Global Catch of a Country

## 📊 Summary analyses

Composition, stock status, trends, data quality, diversity and fleets.

- [`species_group_composition()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/species_group_composition.md)
  : Catch Composition by Species Group
- [`stock_status()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/stock_status.md)
  : Stock Status Plots
- [`peak_trend()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/peak_trend.md)
  : Peak Catch and Recent Trend
- [`area_overview()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/area_overview.md)
  : Overview of All FAO Marine Fishing Areas
- [`data_quality()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/data_quality.md)
  : Data Quality of the Catch Statistics
- [`diversity_concentration()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/diversity_concentration.md)
  : Diversity and Concentration of the Catch
- [`country_group_summary()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_group_summary.md)
  : Catch by Country Group
- [`regime_shift()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/regime_shift.md)
  : Synchronous Breakpoints in the Catch of the Main Species
- [`coastal_distant()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/coastal_distant.md)
  : Catch by Coastal Countries and Distant-Water Fleets

## 🔬 Literature-based analyses

Analyses that follow published methods, each citing its sources.

- [`catch_shocks()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/catch_shocks.md)
  : Catch Shocks
- [`collapse_analysis()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/collapse_analysis.md)
  : Fishery Collapses
- [`catch_synchrony()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/catch_synchrony.md)
  : Synchrony and Stability of the Catch
- [`distant_water_profile()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/distant_water_profile.md)
  : Distant-Water Profile of a Country
- [`compare_releases()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/compare_releases.md)
  : Compare Two FAO Data Releases
- [`pelagic_demersal()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/pelagic_demersal.md)
  : Pelagic/Demersal Catch Ratio
- [`fao_pd_groups()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_pd_groups.md)
  : Pelagic and Demersal Species Groups

## 🌡️ FishBase and temperature

Species traits from FishBase and SeaLifeBase, sea surface temperature,
and the mean temperature of the catch.

- [`check_fishbase_update()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/check_fishbase_update.md)
  : Check for the Latest FishBase and SeaLifeBase Releases
- [`download_fishbase_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/download_fishbase_data.md)
  : Download FishBase and SeaLifeBase Data
- [`fishbase_table()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishbase_table.md)
  : Read a FishBase or SeaLifeBase Table
- [`fishbase_match()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishbase_match.md)
  : Match FAO Species Items to FishBase and SeaLifeBase
- [`fishbase_sources()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishbase_sources.md)
  : Sources, Licences and Matching Rules of the FishBase Data
- [`fao_sst_products()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_sst_products.md)
  : Sea Surface Temperature Products
- [`download_sst_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/download_sst_data.md)
  : Download a Sea Surface Temperature Product
- [`fao_area_sst()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_area_sst.md)
  : Sea Surface Temperature of the FAO Major Fishing Areas
- [`mean_temperature_catch()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/mean_temperature_catch.md)
  : Mean Temperature of the Catch

## 📉 CMSY++ stock assessment

Catch-only stock assessment with the bundled CMSY++ code, FishBase
priors and JAGS set up for the operating system.

- [`cmsy_area()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_area.md)
  : Run CMSY++ for the Main Species of a Fishing Area
- [`cmsy_system()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_system.md)
  : Check the Computer for CMSY++ and Choose the Settings for It
- [`cmsy_setup()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_setup.md)
  : Install JAGS and the R Packages Needed by CMSY++
- [`cmsy_jags_versions()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_jags_versions.md)
  : Which JAGS Version Goes with Which R Version
- [`cmsy_download_jags()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_download_jags.md)
  : Download the JAGS Installer that Matches This Computer
- [`cmsy_install_jags()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_install_jags.md)
  : Download and Open the JAGS Installer
- [`cmsy_sources()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_sources.md)
  : Sources of CMSY++ and the Software It Needs
- [`cmsy_priors()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_priors.md)
  : FishBase and SeaLifeBase Priors for CMSY++
- [`cmsy_input()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_input.md)
  : Prepare FAO Catch Data for CMSY++
- [`cmsy_defaults()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_defaults.md)
  : Settings of CMSY++ and Their Defaults
- [`cmsy_run()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_run.md)
  : Run CMSY++ on FAO Catch Data
- [`cmsy_plot()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_plot.md)
  : Charts of CMSY++ Results
- [`cmsy_forecast()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_forecast.md)
  : Project CMSY++ Results under Fishing Scenarios
- [`cmsy_compare()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_compare.md)
  : Compare CMSY++ Runs, or CMSY++ with Other Assessments
- [`cmsy_tables()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/cmsy_tables.md)
  : Tables of CMSY++ Priors and Results for Reports

## 📝 Reports

A Word report of a fishing area, in Chinese or English, written from the
results.

- [`fao_report()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_report.md)
  : Assessment Report of an FAO Fishing Area

## 🧩 Extensions: other FAO datasets

FAO fishery statistics other than global capture production: catch by
subarea and division from regional fishery bodies (also used by
`pelagic_demersal(by = "division")` and
`mean_temperature_catch(by = "division")`), trade and employment, and
how they compare with the catch. Not part of the Word report.

- [`load_fao_divisions()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/load_fao_divisions.md)
  : Catch by Division: FAO Data of the Regional Fishery Bodies
- [`load_fao_trade()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/load_fao_trade.md)
  : Trade of Aquatic Products: FAO Data
- [`catch_trade()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/catch_trade.md)
  : Catch and Trade of the Species Groups Mostly Caught
- [`fao_capture_groups()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_capture_groups.md)
  : Species Groups Mostly Caught, Not Farmed
- [`load_fao_employment()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/load_fao_employment.md)
  : Employment in Fisheries and Aquaculture: FAO Data
- [`employment_summary()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/employment_summary.md)
  : Employment in Fisheries and Aquaculture by Year
- [`catch_per_fisher()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/catch_per_fisher.md)
  : Catch per Fisher

## 🎨 Settings and language

Chart style, map projection, colours, fonts and Chinese names.

- [`fao_settings()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_settings.md)
  : Settings for Charts, Maps and Output
- [`fao_font()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_font.md)
  : Font Used for Chart Text
- [`fao_translate()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_translate.md)
  : Translate FAO Country, Species or Fishing Area Names

# Articles

### Guides

- [🚀 Get
  started](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/get-started.md):

  Install faofishingreport, update the FAO data, produce the first
  charts for the Eastern Central Atlantic (FAO area 34) and write a Word
  report in one call.

- [🎓 Tutorial: the Northeast Pacific (FAO area 67) from zero to a
  report](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/tutorial-67.md):

  A complete worked example: get the FAO data, analyse FAO major fishing
  area 67 (Alaska, Canada and the US west coast) step by step with every
  function of the package, read and interpret each chart, find the files
  the package saves, and export the assessment report as Word, LaTeX and
  PDF.

- [💾 FAO data: download and
  customise](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/data.md):

  Where the data come from, how to check for and download FAO releases,
  the data format, and how to analyse your own subsets.

- [🌊 Fishing area
  analysis](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/fishing-areas.md):

  fishing_area_data(), fishing_area_species() and
  fishing_area_country(): total catch, main species and main countries
  of an FAO fishing area, with all options.

- [🐟 Species and
  countries](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/species-countries.md):

  species_country(), country_species() and country_analysis(): who
  catches a species, what a country catches in an area, and a country’s
  catch in all FAO areas.

- [📈 Composition, stock status and
  trends](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/status-trends.md):

  species_group_composition(), stock_status(), peak_trend(),
  area_overview(), regime_shift(), pelagic_demersal() and
  fao_pd_groups(): what is caught, how the stocks have developed, and
  when things changed.

- [🔍 Data quality, diversity and
  fleets](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/quality-diversity-fleets.md):

  data_quality(), diversity_concentration(), country_group_summary() and
  coastal_distant(): how reliable the data are, how diverse and
  concentrated the catch is, and who is fishing.

- [🔬 Shocks, collapses, synchrony and
  fleets](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/literature-analyses.md):

  catch_shocks(), collapse_analysis(), catch_synchrony(),
  distant_water_profile() and compare_releases(): abrupt falls and
  collapses of the catch, how synchronously catches fluctuate, where a
  country’s fleets fish, and what FAO revised between two data releases,
  each following published methods.

- [🌡️ Sea temperature and catch
  temperature](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/sst-mtc.md):

  fao_sst_products(), fao_area_sst(), download_sst_data() and
  mean_temperature_catch(): the sea surface temperature of the FAO
  fishing areas, how to use your own SST files, and what you must check
  before using the mean temperature of the catch.

- [🐠 FishBase and SeaLifeBase
  traits](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/fishbase.md):

  check_fishbase_update(), download_fishbase_data(), fishbase_table(),
  fishbase_match() and fishbase_sources(): species traits from FishBase
  and SeaLifeBase, how they are matched to the FAO species items, and
  how the mean temperature of the catch and the CMSY++ priors use them.

- [📉 CMSY++ catch-only stock
  assessment](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/cmsy.md):

  cmsy_area(), cmsy_system(), cmsy_setup(), cmsy_install_jags(),
  cmsy_download_jags(), cmsy_jags_versions(), cmsy_sources(),
  cmsy_priors(), cmsy_input(), cmsy_defaults(), cmsy_run(), cmsy_plot(),
  cmsy_forecast(), cmsy_compare() and cmsy_tables(): catch-only
  assessments of FAO catch series with the bundled CMSY++ code, FishBase
  priors and JAGS.

- [📝 Assessment report: Word, LaTeX and
  PDF](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/report.md):

  fao_report(): an assessment report of an FAO fishing area in Chinese
  or English in one call, as Word, LaTeX or PDF. Its contents,
  arguments, sections and their settings, format, citation styles, the
  CMSY++ part, the tables it returns and the templates of its text.

- [🎨 Customise charts and
  maps](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/customise.md):

  fao_settings(): language, theme, colour palettes, map projection and
  centre, fonts, grid lines, resolution, PowerPoint output and data
  folders.

### 中文文档

- [faofishingreport
  中文文档](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/index.md):

  用 FAO
  全球捕捞产量数据，按渔区、国家和物种生成报告用的图表、地图和表格，支持中文、英文和中英双语。

- [🚀
  快速入门](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/get-started.md):

  安装faofishingreport，更新FAO数据，为中东大西洋（FAO
  34渔区）绘制第一批图表，并一键生成Word报告。

- [🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO
  67区）从零到报告](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/tutorial-67.md):

  一个完整的实例：获取FAO数据，用本包的几乎全部函数一步步分析FAO
  67渔区（阿拉斯加、加拿大和美国西海岸），看懂并解读每张图，找到本包保存的文件，并把评估报告导出为Word、LaTeX和PDF。

- [💾
  FAO数据：下载与自定义](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/data.md):

  数据从哪里来，如何检查和下载FAO的新版本，数据格式是什么样的，
  以及如何分析自己的数据子集。

- [🌊
  渔区分析](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/fishing-areas.md):

  fishing_area_data()、fishing_area_species()和fishing_area_country()：某个FAO渔区的总产量、主要物种和主要捕捞国家，以及全部选项。

- [🐟
  物种与国家分析](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/species-countries.md):

  species_country()、country_species()和country_analysis()：某个物种由哪些国家捕捞，某个国家在一个渔区捕什么，以及某个国家在全部FAO渔区的产量。

- [📈
  类群结构、资源状态与趋势](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/status-trends.md):

  species_group_composition()、stock_status()、peak_trend()、area_overview()、regime_shift()、pelagic_demersal()和fao_pd_groups()：捕捞了什么，各种群如何发展，以及何时发生了变化。

- [🔍
  数据质量、多样性与船队](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/quality-diversity-fleets.md):

  data_quality()、diversity_concentration()、country_group_summary()和coastal_distant()：数据有多可靠，产量的多样性和集中程度如何，以及是谁在捕捞。

- [🔬
  渔获骤变、渔业崩溃、同步性与远洋捕捞](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/literature-analyses.md):

  catch_shocks()、collapse_analysis()、catch_synchrony()、distant_water_profile()和compare_releases()：按已发表的方法识别渔获量的骤降和崩溃，衡量各渔获序列波动的同步程度，追踪一个国家的船队在哪些渔区作业，并查看FAO在两个数据版本之间修订了什么。

- [🌡️
  海表温度与渔获平均温度](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/sst-mtc.md):

  fao_sst_products()、fao_area_sst()、download_sst_data()和mean_temperature_catch()：FAO渔区的海表温度，如何使用自己的SST文件，以及使用渔获平均温度之前必须核对的内容。

- [🐠 FishBase 与 SeaLifeBase
  物种特征](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/fishbase.md):

  check_fishbase_update()、download_fishbase_data()、fishbase_table()、fishbase_match()和fishbase_sources()：FishBase与SeaLifeBase的物种特征，它们如何与FAO物种条目匹配，以及渔获平均温度和CMSY++先验如何使用这些特征。

- [📉
  CMSY++仅渔获量资源评估](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/cmsy.md):

  cmsy_area()、cmsy_system()、cmsy_setup()、cmsy_install_jags()、cmsy_download_jags()、cmsy_jags_versions()、cmsy_sources()、cmsy_priors()、cmsy_input()、cmsy_defaults()、cmsy_run()、cmsy_plot()、cmsy_forecast()、cmsy_compare()和cmsy_tables()：用包内置的CMSY++代码、FishBase先验和JAGS，对FAO渔获序列做仅渔获量评估。

- [📝
  一键生成评估报告（Word、LaTeX、PDF）](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/report.md):

  fao_report()：一次调用即可生成某个FAO渔区的中文或英文评估报告（Word、LaTeX或PDF）。本文介绍报告的内容、参数、各分析章节及其设置、格式、引文格式、CMSY++部分、返回的表格以及报告文字的模板。

- [🎨
  自定义图表与地图](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/customise.md):

  fao_settings()：语言、主题、色板、地图投影与中心、字体、网格线、分辨率、PowerPoint输出和数据文件夹。

### 🧩 Extensions · 扩展

Other FAO datasets, not part of the Word report ·
FAO其他数据集，不纳入Word报告

- [🚢 Trade and
  employment](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/trade-employment.md):

  load_fao_trade(), catch_trade(), fao_capture_groups(),
  load_fao_employment(), employment_summary() and catch_per_fisher():
  how much of a country’s catch is exported, and how many people fish
  and farm, from two more FAO datasets.

- [🚢
  贸易与就业](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/zh/trade-employment.md):

  load_fao_trade()、catch_trade()、fao_capture_groups()、load_fao_employment()、employment_summary()和catch_per_fisher()：用FAO另外两个数据集看一国渔获有多少出口，以及有多少人从事捕捞和养殖。
